patch.summary: Apify cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Apify pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Apify cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Apify against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want ready-made or custom Actors rather than raw proxy ops requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Prepaid usage does not roll over — unused credits expire each cycle

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Actor Store and proxy GB costs can exceed the plan sticker quickly

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not an enterprise proxy-network-first buy like Bright Data / Oxylabs

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git, or hosting panel

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Free plan blocks when prepaid usage is exhausted until next cycle

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Apify on identical constraints.
